LESSON: WORK: GOD WORKED

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Creation 1.1 Work 8 2.0 The Bible 2.1 Christian Moral Values 10 2.2 Kings David 
Topic 1.1: Work: God Worked

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Work: God Worked. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why should you work hard as a Christian?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. discuss virtues related to Christian work ethics
2. demonstrate a positive attitude towards work in daily activities

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: WORK: GOD WORKED
This lesson teaches Work: God Worked for Grade 9 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. discuss virtues related to Christian work ethics
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. demonstrate a positive attitude towards work in daily activities
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Work: God Worked using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Work: God Worked above.
2. Explain Work: God Worked to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Work: God Worked.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Work: God Worked with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Work: God Worked important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should you work hard as a Christian?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. discuss virtues related to Christian work ethics
2. demonstrate a positive attitude towards work in daily activities

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
